description: Defines a type-safe wrapper for display IDs in Android, including classes for physical, virtual, and HAL display IDs with associated methods and constants.

classes.name: DisplayId
classes.description: A type-safe wrapper around uint64_t representing a display ID, with flags for virtual and stable IDs.

classes.name: PhysicalDisplayId
classes.description: Represents a physical display ID, with methods to create stable IDs from EDID info and extract manufacturer and port.

classes.name: VirtualDisplayId
classes.description: Represents a virtual display ID, with flags indicating GPU backing.

classes.name: HalVirtualDisplayId
classes.description: A specific type of virtual display ID used by HAL.

classes.name: GpuVirtualDisplayId
classes.description: A virtual display ID backed by GPU.

classes.name: HalDisplayId
classes.description: ID of a display managed by HWC, convertible from physical or virtual display IDs.

methods.name: fromValue
methods.description: Creates an optional DisplayId or derived ID from a uint64_t value.

methods.name: tryCast
methods.description: Attempts to cast a DisplayId to a specific derived ID type, returning std::nullopt if not applicable.

methods.name: getManufacturerId
methods.description: Extracts the manufacturer ID from a PhysicalDisplayId.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Extracts the port number from a PhysicalDisplayId.
